title: fix(objectql): a package refused while it registers leaves nothing of itself registered
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5msfqLqaCnM87sgNXCJAt3)_

Refs #28697

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `SchemaRegistry.uninstallPackage` gains an optional `options` parameter
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`registerApp` 在注册中途拒绝一个包时，不再留下这个包的任何东西。首次安装被拒：包记录、对象、扩展、应用、条目、导航贡献、kind、数据源定义、嵌套插件命名空间都不留。已安装的包升级被拒且问题只在包体本身：原版本原样继续服务。
- **为什么改**：被拒的包以前会部分留在运行中的系统里，直到重启。拒绝本身（错误码、状态、文字）不变，变的只是留下了什么。
- **风险与回滚**：objectql patch。只看包体就能判的拒绝提前到任何写入之前；只有注册表能判的拒绝，首次安装时用注册表自己的卸载撤回。升级中途被注册表拒绝的情况，以及接管了租户对象的安装，不撤回，行为与以前相同。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 的 `registerApp`（预检、`registerPackageBody`、成功后才写的部分）、`refusedRegistrationWithdrawable` 和 `withdrawRefusedRegistration`；`registry.ts` 的 `uninstallPackage` 新增可选参数。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-refused-registration-withdrawn.test.ts`，预期 24 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Every refusal that the body alone decides is asked before anything registers.** This covers the collection seam's refusals (an item naming another package as its owner, a view container whose name differs from its key, a permission set naming another package, a `views:` entry that is not a container, a `viewItems:` entry its schema refuses) and the seed step's owner-stamp refusal, for the package body and for each nested plugin. The judges are the same functions with the same words. They moved out of the registration loop into `packageBodyCollectionRefusal` and `packageBodySeedDataRefusal`, so there is still one copy of each. The `viewItems:` text moved into `assembledViewItemRefusal`, which both the pre-pass and the loop call.
- **A first install that the registry refuses part-way is withdrawn.** If the package id has no record yet, `registerApp` hands the refusal back unchanged after withdrawing what it wrote, through `SchemaRegistry.uninstallPackage`. It also releases a nested plugin's own namespace. Whether to withdraw is decided before the first write (`refusedRegistrationWithdrawable`). The answer is no for an installed id, since the uninstall would take the installed version with it. It is also no when the body takes over or layers onto an object someone else already holds (a tenant's object, an overlay or an extension with no owner), because withdrawing would drop that layer.
- **The engine's own writes come last.** The package manifest it keeps for datasource routing, the datasource definitions, navigation contributions and contributed kinds are written only after the body registers whole. Nothing that runs before them reads them.
- **`uninstallPackage(id, options?)`** takes an optional `{ keepBootSeed: true }`, so a withdrawn first install does not forget a persisted "disabled" state for its id. An operator's uninstall is unchanged.
- The shared registry test double (`registry-module-mock.ts`) models `getPackage` and `getObjectContributors` as empty.

## Why

What the install refuses should leave the running system exactly as it was, so the operator can fix the package and install it again, and an upgrade that fails leaves the previous version running.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-refused-registration-withdrawn.test.ts` (new, 24 tests):
  - each body-only refusal, on a fresh id: same code and status, nothing of the package left in any registry the engine owns;
  - the same eight on a re-register of an installed `1.0.0`: the installed version reads exactly as before;
  - registry refusals part-way through a first install (a field with no `type`, an object another package owns, a repeated picklist value, the same from a nested plugin): withdrawn, the other package's object and list untouched, and the boot seed of disabled packages kept;
  - controls: a clean body registers into every registry as before; a body that took over a tenant's object is not withdrawn and the tenant's layer keeps serving; an installed id refused part-way by the registry is not withdrawn.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/install-local-refused-package-leaves-nothing.dogfood.test.ts` (new): through `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` on the showcase, a refused install leaves `GET /packages/:id`, its object and its app at 404, and the same id then installs 200. A registry refusal part-way leaves the package and its first object at 404, and the showcase's object still reads. A refused upgrade leaves the package at `1.0.0` with its object and app reading, and v2's new object at 404.

## Acceptance notes

- A body with more than one defect may now be refused for a different one than before, because body-only refusals are asked first. Each refusal's code, status and words are unchanged.
- Not changed here, with the seat: an upgrade the registry refuses part-way, and an install that took over a tenant's object, are not withdrawn. Both keep today's behaviour, and the unit controls state it.
